lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Change request CR-2005-006 - nitrogen flush on filling line FL-2
Filling line FL-2 is shared by EF-210 Part A (epoxy base) and Part B (amine hardener
Amine hardeners react with carbon dioxide and moisture in air (carbamation, white crust
Change: flush every pail with nitrogen before filling on FL-2. Applied to all products filled
on the line, to avoid changeover mistakes.
